name: Algebraic Framing
description: Translates a graph connectivity problem (Steiner tree on a tree) into an equivalent algebraic problem of selecting linear equality constraints. This strips all graph-theoretic keywords (path, connected, tree, span, basis) and forces the model to mathematically deduce that transitivity of equality over n-1 constraints forming a full rank system is isomorphic to connectivity in a tree. Models relying on graph keywords will fail to map this to the required subtree DP.
